title: Sources, Editions and Verification
intro: Every substantive record in this app points at one of the entries below. Where a record could not be tied to a source it is marked as awaiting verification rather than being given a plausible-sounding citation.

sources.title: Devi Mahatmyam / Durga Saptashati (ITRANS transcription)
sources.editionNote: ITRANS source dated 26 February 2024 per its own header.
sources.derived: Devanagari and IAST are produced mechanically from the ITRANS with the indic-transliteration library. No verse wording was edited.
sources.licence: The Sanskrit text itself is ancient and out of copyright. The transcription is volunteer work whose header asks that it not be reposted for commercial promotion without permission — see docs/CONTENT_SOURCING.md before shipping.
sources.verification: scripts/verify-scripture.ts checks all 13 chapters, verse numbering continuity, and that the verse total reconciles with the source's own colophon (700).

sources.title: The Markandeya Purana — Devi Mahatmya (English translation)
sources.author: F. Eden Pargiter
sources.published: Bibliotheca Indica, Asiatic Society of Bengal, Calcutta, 1904
caveats: The OCR is uncorrected; spelling artefacts are preserved rather than silently fixed.
OCR verse numbers are corrupt, so no verse-level alignment is offered.
Canto XCIII is truncated in this witness; chapter 13 is incomplete.

sources.title: Navadurga Stotram (nine dhyana shlokas)
sources.provenance: Traditional; text as printed in Parayan Grantham (पारायण ग्रन्थम्)
caveats: Not collated against a critical edition. Wording differs between lineages.

sources.title: Tithi / nakshatra / Navratri date computation
sources.provenance: Jean Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms (2nd ed.), ch. 22, 25 and 47
caveats: Low-precision series: about 0.01 degrees for the Sun, 0.3 degrees for the Moon.
Tropical (nirayana) longitudes are used; no ayanamsha is applied. Traditions that use sidereal reckoning can place a tithi boundary differently.
No muhurat is hard-coded. All timings are computed for the selected location.
sources.verification: tests/panchang.test.ts checks the engine against four independently known syzygies (2000 and 2024 new and full moons).

sources.title: Shakti Peetha enumerations
sources.provenance: Puranic and tantric lists (Pithanirnaya and related), plus regional temple traditions and modern reference works
caveats: There is no single agreed list. The 18, 51, 52, 64 and 108 enumerations disagree.
Body-part attributions differ between recensions for many sites.
No official website, darshan timing or transport detail has been invented.

sources.title: Editorial explanations, stories, glossary and guides
caveats: Editorial content authored for this app. It has not been through independent scholarly review. See the Content Verification page.
